title: Your Call Is Important To Us (Hold Music Rave Flip)
style: elevator muzak intro on cheap MIDI panflute, slowly transforming into euphoric piano house at 126 bpm, big room rave drop on the chorus, deadpan female corporate voice saying the title, bouncy supersaw stabs, hand claps, gated reverb snare, hold-music kitsch flipped into stadium banger, 336 hz subharmonic under the kick, comedic but danceable
lyrics:
[Intro — cheesy panflute muzak]
(robotic female) Your call is important to us…
Please continue to hold…
Estimated wait time… forever…

[Verse 1]
I've been on this line since the sun came up
Three little notes on a loop, won't stop
Panflute, harp, a fake guitar
Living in this elevator from afar

[Pre-Drop]
They said five minutes, that was an hour ago
But my call is important, the robot told me so

[Drop]
Your call — your call — your call is important to us
Your call — your call — keep holding on the bus
Your call — your call — the panflute never stops
Three-three-six on the queue — keep dancing till it drops

[Verse 2]
Press one for English, press two to weep
Press three if you'd like to fall asleep
Press nine to admit that you've been beat
Press zero for a human, repeat repeat

[Drop]
Your call — your call — your call is important to us
Your call — your call — keep holding on the bus
Your call — your call — the panflute never stops
Three-three-six on the queue — keep dancing till it drops

[Outro — muzak fades]
(robotic female) Thank you for your patience…
Goodbye.
